note: Borders: CShapes 2.0 (Schvitz, Rüegger, Girardin, Cederman, Weidmann, Gleditsch 2022), ETH Zurich ICR, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, from the version in the cshapes R package that records each dependency's status and ruling state. Shown: colonies, protectorates, mandates and occupied territories of Britain, France, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and Italy, and their home states; dependencies of the United States, Japan, Denmark, South Africa, Australia, New Zealand, Russia and Austria-Hungary in grey. Status at the end of each year. CShapes follows the Gleditsch-Ward state list: self-governing dominions (Canada from 1886, Australia from 1901, New Zealand from 1907, South Africa from 1910) count as independent; the Congo Free State (1885-1908), King Leopold II's personal possession, is listed under Belgium; changes under about 10,000 km² are left out. Orbis cut each empire into pieces with their own dates so gains and losses can be highlighted, and simplified the shapes. This derived file is distributed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, like its source.
